xcodebuildCommand: xcodebuild test -project SanePeek.xcodeproj -scheme SanePeek -configuration Debug -destination 'platform=macOS' -only-testing:SanePeekPerformanceTests -enablePerformanceTestsDiagnostics NO -test-timeouts-enabled YES -default-test-execution-time-allowance 120 -maximum-test-execution-time-allowance 300
notes: Readers, feeds, settings, and active metric selections are deterministic fixtures.
The menu-bar label measurement renders both number and bar modes across 700 deterministic inputs.
The monitor measurement uses preview content and isolated defaults; it is not a hardware or live-user-settings benchmark.
XCTest performance measurements are baselines and budgets are reviewed separately from ordinary correctness-test pass/fail results.
Release profiling and multi-hour/day idle observation remain manual release-signoff evidence.
